description: This file implements a PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) driver for Zephyr OS, utilizing UART communication (uart_pipe). It manages PPP packet framing, transmission, reception, and interface initialization, including support for asynchronous UART and network statistics.

methods.name: ppp_callback
methods.description: UART event callback handling transmission, reception, buffer management, and error recovery for asynchronous UART.

methods.name: ppp_async_uart_rx_enable
methods.description: Enables UART reception in asynchronous mode with callback setup.

methods.name: uart_recovery
methods.description: Handles UART recovery after errors or disabled state, re-enabling reception.

methods.name: ppp_save_byte
methods.description: Saves a received byte into a net_pkt buffer, allocating new buffers as needed.

methods.name: ppp_driver_state_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of PPP driver state.

methods.name: ppp_change_state
methods.description: Transitions the PPP driver state with debug logging.

methods.name: ppp_send_flush
methods.description: Flushes the send buffer over UART, using FIFO fill or polling depending on configuration.

methods.name: ppp_send_bytes
methods.description: Copies data bytes into the send buffer, flushing when full.

methods.name: ppp_handle_client
methods.description: Handles PPP client string recognition and responds with client-server string.

methods.name: ppp_input_byte
methods.description: Processes a single byte of PPP frame, managing HDLC framing, escaping, and state transitions.

methods.name: ppp_check_fcs
methods.description: Verifies the Frame Check Sequence (FCS) of a PPP packet.

methods.name: ppp_process_msg
methods.description: Processes a complete PPP message, verifying FCS and passing to network interface.

methods.name: ppp_recv_cb
methods.description: Receives data buffer, feeds bytes into PPP input processing, used in testing.

methods.name: ppp_driver_feed_data
methods.description: Feeds large chunks of data into PPP driver for testing purposes.

methods.name: calc_fcs
methods.description: Calculates the FCS for a given PPP packet.

methods.name: ppp_escape_byte
methods.description: Escapes special bytes in PPP framing according to HDLC rules.

methods.name: ppp_send
methods.description: Constructs and sends a PPP frame over UART, including framing, escaping, and FCS.

methods.name: ppp_consume_ringbuf
methods.description: Consumes data from ring buffer, feeding bytes into PPP input state machine.

methods.name: ppp_isr_cb_work
methods.description: Work handler for processing ring buffer data in interrupt context.

methods.name: ppp_driver_init
methods.description: Initializes PPP driver context, ring buffer, work queues, and state.

methods.name: ppp_get_mac
methods.description: Returns the MAC address link-layer address structure.

methods.name: ppp_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, sets MAC address, and configures auto-start behavior.

methods.name: ppp_get_stats
methods.description: Returns PPP statistics structure.

methods.name: ppp_start
methods.description: Starts PPP interface, initializes UART device, and enables carrier.

methods.name: ppp_stop
methods.description: Stops PPP interface and disables UART reception.
